_comment: Decisions 34-36 mockups (workbench, fake backend). UX review 1 triaged in docs/active/reviews/2026-09-24-plans-spending-ux-review-1.md. Before = the branch before the spending rework; After = feat/specialists-plans-ui at db8761b84.
title: Plans — spending without per-step budgets

steps.path: A plan waiting for your approval
steps.headline: The card shows what a plan usually costs instead of a worst-case limit, with a small gear for plan settings.
steps.changed: "Up to about $0.12 (40,000 tokens) · specialists run on Claude Sonnet 4.6" becomes "Usually $0.40–$2", worked out from past runs of these kinds of specialists on these models. A gear button now sits left of Comment and Approve.
steps.notice: You see a realistic cost before approving, and pressing Approve starts the plan with no limit. The range is an estimate, so a big plan can still cost more than its high end.

steps.path: A plan waiting for approval that runs on a model on your computer
steps.headline: A plan that isn't charged per word shows its rough size in tokens, and says why there's no dollar figure.
steps.changed: The old worst-case line becomes "About 300,000 tokens · runs on your computer" (or "· included in your ChatGPT plan" when signed in with ChatGPT).
steps.notice: You can tell a plan costs nothing extra, and still see roughly how big it is.

steps.headline: A running plan shows what it has spent so far, and the small limit on each step is gone.
steps.changed: "Spent $0.03 (11,200 tokens) of the $0.12 limit (40,000 tokens)" becomes "Spent $0.03". The "up to 9,000 tokens" on each step and the "Limits" section inside an open step are removed; the open step names its model instead.
steps.notice: Specialists no longer stop on a small per-step allowance. Stop the plan is always there, beside the gear for plan settings. With no limit set, only Stop keeps an expensive plan from finishing.

steps.path: A plan that reached the spending limit you set
steps.headline: A plan only pauses at the one limit you set, and continues when you give it a new one — no more Add budget.
steps.changed: "Paused — step 1 hit its 27,000-token limit" with Ask the assistant · Stop · Add budget becomes one row: "Reached your $5 limit." with Stop and Continue.
steps.notice: This only happens if you set a limit. The spending line above it is gone, because the row already says it. Ask the assistant is not on this row. It still appears for every other kind of pause.

steps.path: A running plan you set a $5 limit on
steps.headline: With a limit set, the running card shows spending against it.
steps.changed: "Spent $0.03 of $5". Without a limit it reads just "Spent $0.03".
steps.notice: You can watch how close the plan is to your limit while it works.

steps.path: A plan that reached its limit, after pressing Continue
steps.headline: Continue asks for a new total limit right in the row.
steps.changed: Continue opens a "New limit $" box, with Cancel and Continue. The number is the new total, not an amount added on top.
steps.notice: One step to keep going. You can also raise or remove the limit in plan settings.

steps.path: Plan settings, with a limit lower than the plan usually costs
steps.headline: A limit below the plan's usual cost gets a one-line warning before you approve.
steps.changed: Under the amount: "Below what this plan usually costs, so it may pause before it finishes." The empty box shows the usual high cost as a grey example.
steps.notice: You find out a low limit will probably stop the plan partway before it happens, not after.

steps.path: A plan waiting for approval, after pressing the gear (or the Plan settings row)
steps.headline: Where should a plan's settings open: a popup over the chat, or a section inside the plan card?
steps.notice: Either way it holds the same things: the optional spending limit, and a model for each step, set to that specialist's default until you change it. The outside tester preferred the in-card version because the popup covers the plan it is changing.

variants.label: Popup
variants.summary: The gear opens a small window over the chat. Close it to see the plan again.
variants.risk: Covers the plan's steps while you choose models for them.

variants.label: Inside the card
variants.summary: A Plan settings row under the buttons opens the same fields inside the card, beneath the steps.
variants.risk: The card gets taller while it is open.
